cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
# Extract Stan code from R file
r = open("gp_rstan.R").read()
m = re.search(r'stan_code <- "(.*)"\s*\n\s*writeLines', r, re.DOTALL)
r_stan = m.group(1)
# Extract STAN_PROGRAM from python
py = open("pystan_analysis.py").read()
m2 = re.search(r'STAN_PROGRAM = """(.*?)"""', py, re.DOTALL)
py_stan = m2.group(1)

# Normalize: strip leading/trailing whitespace per line and drop blank lines for comparison
def norm(s):
    lines = [l.rstrip() for l in s.splitlines()]
    return [l for l in lines if l.strip() != ""]

rn = norm(r_stan)
pn = norm(py_stan)
print("R stan lines:", len(rn), " Py stan lines:", len(pn))
import difflib
diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(rn, pn, lineterm="", n=1))
if diff:
    print("DIFFERENCES FOUND:")
    print("\n".join(diff))
else:
    print("IDENTICAL (ignoring blank lines/leading indent)")
EOF
